passages.text: When you see someone in a sorry state, in distress, you should conclude: ‘In all this long time, we too have undergone the same thing.’
passages.note: Compassion by remembering we have suffered the same

passages.text: Oh! Conditions are impermanent, their nature is to rise and fall; having arisen, they cease; their settling is such bliss.”
passages.note: Everything changes; peace in letting things settle
